_readme: HAND-MAINTAINED. Who Ask AirMax shows when it cannot fix a problem. Edit this file only; no code change is needed and the how-to build never overwrites it. Every contact value is a placeholder until the owner provides the real one: a value that is empty or starts with TBD is shown as 'Contact details coming soon'. Do not guess numbers, emails or web addresses. Fields per contact: name, what, phone, email, url, hours, address, note. 'routes' go top to bottom: the first route with a keyword found in the question picks the contact; 'default' is used when none match.
